How the rules work

Browsing is openCatalogue, product pages, quotations, planner and basket need no account.
Ordering needs oneCheckout asks to sign in or create an account and returns you to the review step.
Sign in three waysEmail, Kenyan mobile number or username — all normalised to one account.
Passwords are hashedSHA-256 with a per-account salt where the browser allows it; never stored in plain text.
Demo loginsdemo@norvex.co.ke and admin@norvex.co.ke — password Norvex2026.
Catalogue overridesAdmin edits are layered over the shipped 45-SKU catalogue and applied everywhere instantly.
